p.strong: Guidance to Law Comparison — end-to-end journey

g.text: 2. Two source paths (can run in parallel)

div.p: Operator Chooses the audit topic
Audit scope Topic and category brief
Match propositions For each guidance proposition, find related law propositions and label each pair
Pair-level results Each guidance proposition ↔ law proposition pair has its own result (e.g. GROUNDED, CONFLICTS, GUIDANCE_INCOMPLETE, GUIDANCE_BROADER, GUIDANCE_MISSING, UNGROUNDED)
Guidance-proposition status Overall result for each guidance proposition derived from its set of pair results
Adjudicate flagged pairs Re-check uncertain top matches with page context
Reviewed comparison results Pair results (updated where re-checked) plus guidance-proposition status
Assemble audit Join comparison outputs for presentation
Audit pack Frontend-ready comparison view
Reviewer Inspects findings in the audit frontend
GOV.UK Official guidance
Discover guidance Find and fetch guidance pages
Guidance corpus Candidate guidance pages
Filter for relevance Keep pages on-topic for the audit
On-topic guidance Pages in scope for the topic
Extract guidance propositions Break guidance into atomic claims
Guidance propositions Atomic claims from guidance
Legislation sources Lex search and legislation.gov.uk
Discover legislation Find candidate instruments
Candidate legislation Instruments proposed for the topic
Operator / reviewer Accepts or parks candidates
Selected legislation Accepted sources for extraction
Extract law propositions Break legislation into atomic rules
Law propositions Atomic rules from legislation
